verdict.rationale: Wise documents first-party API bulk operations. Batch groups bundle up to 1000 transfers that are managed as a single unit (wise-docs-28). The multi-currency account can fund single or batch transfers (wise-docs-25), batch transfers can be funded via ACH/EFT direct debit (wise-docs-23), and bulk settlement settles many transfers in one bank transfer (wise-docs-29). missing for 10: bulk operations beyond payments (e.g., bulk card issuance or bulk recipient creation), detail on batch lifecycle and error handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
